model.disclosure: Requests now leave through the real pinned @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm LlmRuntime (provider registry, prepareCall, llm/stream waterfall, LlmAdapter.stream, BlockAssembler), with a local no-network provider standing in for DeepSeek. The dsh-agent-loop package is not installed in this repository, so the step/turn driver is a documented stand-in for it. Token counts and moves are scripted synthetic values, never DeepSeek usage; latency is local harness wall-clock. The reported model is the local adapter envelope value, not a live DeepSeek response. These numbers cannot calibrate production token caps; a real DeepSeek run still needs owner approval, credentials, and a real price schedule.
